inputs: distance-03 retained entry/exit/directions and original frozen case background_estimate capsule. No source reconstruction or RGB read is needed.
selected_rays: The same six sections from correspondence-02/03. Retain all four original AA2 subrays per selected pixel. This yields72 saved rays per case, not newly traced rays.
analytic_only: Solve line intersections with capsule straight sides and cap circles by linear/quadratic formulas. Retain all roots, cap-domain validity, valid-plane condition, entering/leaving status and seams. No iterative root solver or distance grid.
finite_kernel: Retain conservative mixed bands using capsule radius plus/minus sqrt(2)*(finite radius+1.5)/L. This covers full square Gaussian support, bilinear corners and original source pixel coverage. It is an enclosure, not an exact raster boundary or source proof at alternate D.
stop: Answer the concrete question and propose at most one geometry family, or stop at10minutes. No implementation/new surface or subsequent setting before review.
